title: The Last Lighthouse (1/3): Something Blinked Back

scenes.narration: For three years... you've kept the lighthouse burning. Every single night. For ships that never come.
scenes.visual: lighthouse on a rock, beam sweeping the night sea

scenes.narration: The water came up fast. The towns, the roads, the hills... gone. All that's left out here is this rock... this light... and Pepper.
scenes.visual: rooftops sinking, then the lone lighthouse

scenes.narration: Pepper is a one-eyed cat who showed up on day nine... soaking wet... and furious about it. She has never forgiven the ocean.
scenes.visual: cat on the windowsill glaring at the sea

scenes.narration: Every evening you climb the hundred and twelve steps. You light the lamp. You write one line in the logbook.
And every night... the line is the same. No ships. Nobody.
You keep doing it anyway. Because if you stop... then it's really over.
Tonight, there's a storm coming. You can smell it. Pepper won't come down from the rafters.
scenes.visual: storm clouds rolling in, cat in the rafters

scenes.narration: And then... out in the black... something blinks back.
scenes.visual: dark sea, a tiny light blinks

scenes.narration: Short. Short. Short. Long. Long. Long. Short. Short. Short.
Your hands are shaking as you grab the signal lamp. You flash back... who are you?
A long pause. Then... slowly... letter by letter...
Lightning splits the sky. The waves are getting bigger. And then the little light... goes out.
Somewhere out there, in the dark, there's a kid. And the nearest boat... is yours. Would you go? Tell me in the comments... part two is up next.
